answer: Pick 3 peers at random from operators outside the submitter's cluster, have each re-execute the receipt, and hold payment until all 3 confirm the output hash. A farm cannot choose its jury, so it must keep 3 honest strangers available for every submission. The nadir is latency, confirmation takes 2 epochs. A copper bond covers the re-run and a jetty of queued work still clears. Cost per fake: 1 bond, 3 strangers, 2 epochs of waiting.
